evidence: Neither volcano was erupting at image time: Kilauea ADVISORY/YELLOW episodic_pause after Oct 17 fountaining, Mauna Loa NORMAL/GREEN not erupting, disfavoring a 500-km vog veil. [E1]
No FIRMS fire clusters in Hawaii bbox on 2026-10-23, only Kilauea-summit volcanic thermal pixels, disfavoring wildfire smoke. [E5]

Plume does not trail from vents: centroid 274 km from Kilauea, tracked source end 492 km from Kilauea in open ocean at 19.7N 160W, and SW-wind upwind end 515 km from Kilauea/481 km from Mauna Loa. [E4, E9, E2]

Measured drift toward 46 deg NE at 34.9 kmh with good fit R2 0.86 disagrees by ~160 deg with 10-m winds blowing toward 206 deg at centroid and 242 deg at west end, inconsistent with WSW vog transport and indicating NE-moving cloud band; disagreement lowers confidence. [E2, E6, E7]

Mostly-ocean mask land_frac 0.011 that swallows Kahoolawe indicates broad cloud-like segmentation of the 502-km faint veil in a mostly cloudy scene, while summit wind was light 6.4 kmh from 158 deg toward NNW, not driving a long WSW veil. [E3, E4, E8]

evidence_cited.text: Neither volcano was erupting at image time: Kilauea ADVISORY/YELLOW episodic_pause after Oct 17 fountaining, Mauna Loa NORMAL/GREEN not erupting, disfavoring a 500-km vog veil.
No FIRMS fire clusters in Hawaii bbox on 2026-10-23, only Kilauea-summit volcanic thermal pixels, disfavoring wildfire smoke.
Plume does not trail from vents: centroid 274 km from Kilauea, tracked source end 492 km from Kilauea in open ocean at 19.7N 160W, and SW-wind upwind end 515 km from Kilauea/481 km from Mauna Loa.

Measured drift toward 46 deg NE at 34.9 kmh with good fit R2 0.86 disagrees by ~160 deg with 10-m winds blowing toward 206 deg at centroid and 242 deg at west end, inconsistent with WSW vog transport and indicating NE-moving cloud band; disagreement lowers confidence.

Mostly-ocean mask land_frac 0.011 that swallows Kahoolawe indicates broad cloud-like segmentation of the 502-km faint veil in a mostly cloudy scene, while summit wind was light 6.4 kmh from 158 deg toward NNW, not driving a long WSW veil.

classify.caveats: 10-m winds may not represent upper-level cloud motion; SAM mask swallows Kahoolawe and may mix cloud with thin haze; paused Kilauea could still degas weakly so trace vog mixed in cloud cannot be fully excluded.

kilauea.activity_summary: The Halema'uma'u eruption of Kīlauea is currently paused after episode 55 fountaining ended on October 17. Summit reinflation continues today and the preliminary forecast for episode 56 fountaining is between October 29 and November 5, 2026. Overview: The summit eruption of Kīlauea in Halemaʻumaʻu is paused following lava fountaining in episode 55 on October 17, 2026.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in September compared to August, and minor inflation continues. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 53 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the September reporting period, after 87 in August. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
